kpis.description_en: Omnipod (tubeless insulin pump) total revenue US + Intl. Insulet core, Omnipod 5 automated growth.

kpis.description_en: US Omnipod revenue: key market, T2 expansion. Tubed pumps + CGM integration competition.

kpis.description_en: Intl Omnipod: mostly EU (Germany, France, UK). Omnipod 5 EU rollout 2024+.

kpis.signal: Hero Insulet, Omnipod 5 dominant, expansion T2 (diabete type 2), CAGR ~30%

kpis.signal: Re-acceleration FY24 (+27.6%) via lancement Omnipod 5 France, Pays-Bas, UK, Allemagne

kpis.description_en: International Omnipod revenue (mainly EU: Germany, UK, France, Netherlands). FY24 re-acceleration driven by Omnipod 5 rollout in new EU markets.

kpis.signal: Cap $2Mds franchi FY24, base ~365k clients Omnipod 5 globaux

kpis.description_en: Total Omnipod products revenue (US + International). Crossed $2B in FY24. ~365k Omnipod 5 customers globally at FY24 end.

kpis.signal: Legacy non-strategique, pods Amgen Neulasta Onpro, declin structurel

kpis.description_en: Drug Delivery revenue: pods supplied to Amgen for Neulasta Onpro (chemo). Legacy activity in structural decline, ~2% of total revenue.

kpis.description_en: Insulet total revenue (Omnipod + Drug Delivery). ~23% 5yr CAGR, sustained hypergrowth driven by Omnipod 5.
